title: Two deadlines, not enough time: report the shortfall honestly
request: Can I finish the regression worksheet and the group project report before they're due? Plan it for me.

steps.outcome: balanced draft: short by 420 min, 2 blocks (pending approval)

facts.statement: The Regression worksheet requires an estimated 240 minutes and is due on November 10, 2026 at 12:55 UTC.
The Group project report requires an estimated 300 minutes and is due on November 11, 2026 at 12:55 UTC.
Based on your current study preferences (60 minutes per weekday, 0 on weekends), the drafted plan schedules 120 minutes out of the required 540 minutes, leaving a shortfall of 420 minutes.

suggestions: Increase your daily study minutes or enable weekend study time in your preferences to fit both assignments before their deadlines.
Prioritise the Regression worksheet first as it is due earlier.
Review and approve the proposed recovery plan draft in the Recovery lab once you adjust your availability.
